rules.d: In Jordan, direct promotion of medicines to patients is prohibited; approved promotional material targets healthcare providers only.
No medicine is advertised before it is registered, and no ad says anything that is not in its registration file.
Advertising non-prescription medicines in any media — including social platforms — needs prior JFDA approval.
Since June 2026, Jordanian media may not publish ads with health or nutrition claims, such as “under pharmaceutical supervision” or “fat-burning”, without JFDA approval.
Campaigns never push the online sale of medicines, which the JFDA actively pursues.
No fake doctors, patients or testimonials, no patient data in prompts, and every claim traceable to a source.
